## Related Issue

<!--
Each PR has one primary issue. A workflow detects it and appends the closing
keyword matching the issue type (Bug: Fixes, Feature: Closes, Task: Resolves)
at the end of this description, between sync-issue-pr markers. Do not edit that
block; it is updated automatically. Allowlisted issue labels are copied to the
PR (removing a label from the issue does not remove it from the PR).

The primary issue is taken from, in order of priority:
1. A closing keyword written here, e.g. "Fixes #123" (kept as written).
2. The issue number at the start of the branch name, e.g. 123-short-name.
3. An issue linked in the PR sidebar (Development); re-run the workflow or
   edit the PR afterwards, since linking alone does not trigger it.
4. "Related to #123" written here.

If the branch name has no issue number, add "Related to #123" (or a closing
keyword) below. Mention other issues without a keyword, e.g. "See also #456".
-->
